answer: Sequential Delay Ledger.** Each identity must complete a fixed chain of timed checkpoints, one per epoch, before gaining full rights; skipping or restarting resets progress to zero. The scarce resource is elapsed verified time, not money. An attacker cloning identities must run every clone through the full sequence in parallel, paying continuous attention and coordination cost per clone for the entire ramp. A short bridge period grants limited access, but the final zenith of permissions requires the full chain; partial progress sits on a terrace and never converts.
